nodes.text: Today is not a shopping day in Nifty. HMPV is still a developing story, we donot know where it will go from here. It is okay to miss few opportunities to buy. Let the market settle, no panic buying or selling. Yeh jo shopping kar rahe hai aaj, yeh log bada discount miss karenge.
